LanguageData.RatkinQL_HealerTree_Report: A traveling healer passed through, offering herbs and home remedies.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_Greeting: He shifts his basket of leaves on his back. “{Interviewer_labelShort}, stocking up on herbs? Or just need a wise old rat’s advice on what ails you?”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_OptBuy: Buy a batch of mixed herbs (30 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_OptRemedy: Ask him for a few folk remedies.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_OptLeave: Say you don't need anything right now.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_Remedy1: “Got a fever? Chew on the root of the yellow-blossom weed. Tastes like dirt, but it’ll sweat it out of you by morning.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_Remedy2: “For a cut that won't stop oozing, pack it with fresh moss from the north side of a tree. Keeps the rot out and the blood in.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_Remedy3: “Can’t sleep? Stuff a pinch of dried night-clover into your pillow. You’ll dream of running through wheat fields.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_Farewell: He hoists his basket and nods goodbye.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Healer_MsgBuy: He counts out a dozen little bundles of herbs, showing you how to brew each one, and pockets your silver with a satisfied nod.
